# Awesome Open Source

> A comprehensive directory for discovering, comparing, and evaluating over 2 million open source projects across 59 categories with curated metrics and collections.

Awesome Open Source serves as a centralized hub for developers and organizations to find, compare, and understand open source projects. The platform aggregates project data across multiple categories, providing curated collections and package metrics to help users make informed decisions about which projects to use or contribute to.

## Key Topics

- open-source-discovery
- project-comparison
- category-directory
- package-metrics
- curated-collections
- open-source-projects
- software-evaluation
- developer-tools
- project-curation
- package-management

## Getting Started

- [Find And Compare Open Source Projects](https://awesomeopensource.com): Homepage for discovering and comparing 2M+ open source projects across 59 categories with package metrics and curated collections
